，天魔影魅！（，天魔影魅！（第22页）“这种存在，作为家里的天机师我必须要知道，将她告诉老爷。”特别强横的存在。难道是“若依，可有探知出来了吗？”江若依摇摇头：“没有，但他的方位距离这里很远，那是一处深不见底的深渊。”“龙钟君，难道他将封印破开了？”听到江若依的描述，李长寿瞬间就想到了这人。先前他火力全开都无法伤到其分毫。叶凝霜的实力并不是巅峰状态。倘若真的是他来了，李家还真有可能完蛋。江若依诧异：“老爷，这么说您知道了？”“嗯，若依你先好好休息，老爷是不会让他伤害到你们的。”经过甜言蜜语之后，江若依虚弱地睡了过去。李长寿没有犹豫，带着叶凝霜直接进入到了东荒姜斓塔中。“霜儿，你怎么看？”此事事关重大，李长寿无力斗过龙钟君，唯有依靠家里这位大帝倚仗手段。“要我看，不一定是龙钟君。”“仙遗族的诅咒就算是大帝九重都不可能轻易破除，按照那老东西的秉性。”“在没有找到合适的肉身，他是舍不得舍去自己的龙躯的。”不等叶凝霜说话，羽炎从中苏醒，说出了自己的猜想。李长寿：“这么说，炎儿很了解他了？”羽炎：“不过是当时随意捏死的蝼蚁，想不到现在成了气候。”终究还是没有肉身，没有实力。不过还差最后的菩提子，只要等血杀殿送来，她便可快速复苏。“姐姐说的不无道理，可我感觉另有其人。”叶凝霜目光凝重：“先前我在黑风之渊探索的时候，就察觉到很多上古时期的种族在这里盘踞沉睡。”“黑风之渊的煞气并非凭空形成，只要待在里面沉睡，能够极大地减缓寿元的衰竭。”“在这样的栖息地下，龙钟君有个帮手再正常不过。”嘶……李长寿忍不住倒吸一口凉气，感到压力山大。光是一个龙钟君就让他感到头都大了，要是再来一群大帝族群。他都不敢想，以后这修仙界都乱成什么样。“我的实力不及全盛时期的十之一二，根本无力抵抗。”“为今之计是让他们找不到咱们的踪迹，比如你可以开辟一个小世界。”“到时候有我用帝境手法帮你遮掩，咱们就有足够的时间休养生息。”叶凝霜的办法倒是不错。堂堂无上帝族李家，岂能住在地下这么一个小地方。一点安全性和逼格都没有。“办法倒是不错，霜儿要不你来？”念及此，李长寿把希望寄托到了叶凝霜身上。主要是大帝跟寻常炼虚合体开辟的小世界相差甚多。不仅大，还异常隐蔽，再随手设置个帝境神通阵法，安全性直接拉满。比他自己费力干要强得多。“好。”叶凝霜一口答应，没有拒绝。且不说她不知道李长寿已经恢复了寿元。现在她还在怀着愧疚心理，生怕李老六有个什么闪失，在开辟世界的时候陨落了。三人离开东荒姜斓塔，来到了虚空上方。

, Tianmo Yingmei! (, Tianmo Yingmei! (Page 22) "This kind of existence, as the secret master of the family, I must know about her and tell the master." A particularly powerful existence. "Ruoyi, have you detected it yet?" Jiang Ruoyi shook his head: "No, but his location is far away from here. It is a bottomless abyss." "Long Zhongjun, did he break the seal?" After hearing Jiang Ruoyi's description, Li Changshou immediately thought of this person. He could not hurt him at all before. Ye Ningshuang's strength was not at its peak. If he really came, Jiang Ruoyi was surprised: "Master, do you understand?" "Well, Ruoyi, you will not let him hurt you." After talking sweetly, Jiang Ruoyi fell asleep weakly. Without hesitation, he led Ye Ningshuang directly into the Jianglan Pagoda of Donghuang. "Shuang'er, what do you think?" This matter was of great importance. Li Changshou was unable to defeat Lord Long Zhong, so he could only rely on the methods of the great emperor in his family. "I think it may not be Lord Long Zhong." "The curse of the Immortal Relic Clan cannot be easily broken even by the ninth level emperor. According to the nature of the old man." "Unless he finds a suitable body, he is willing to give up." I can't bear to give up my dragon body." Before Ye Ningshuang could say anything, Yu Yan woke up and expressed his suspicion. Li Changshou: "So, Yan'er knew him very well?" Yu Yan: "It was just an ant that was crushed to death at random. I didn't expect it to be like this now." After all, she still has no body and no strength. But she still needs the last Bodhi seed. She can recover quickly as long as she waits for the Blood Killing Palace to arrive. It makes sense, but I feel that there is someone else. "Ye Ningshuang looked solemnly: "When I was exploring the Black Wind Abyss, I noticed that many races from the ancient times were sleeping here. "The evil energy of the Black Wind Abyss is not formed out of thin air. As long as you stay in it and sleep, it can greatly slow down the decline of Shou Yuan." "In such a habitat, it is normal for Long Zhongjun to have a helper." He couldn't help but take a breath and feel the pressure. Just one Long Zhongjun made his head feel heavy. If another group of emperors came, he couldn't imagine what kind of chaos the world of immortals would be in the future. "My strength is not as good as 10/20 of what it was in its heyday." "The plan for now is to prevent them from finding our traces. For example, you can open up a small world for me." The method will help you cover up, and we will have enough time to recuperate. "Ye Ningshuang's method is good. How can the Li family, who is a godless clan, live in such a small place underground. There is no security or quality at all. "It's a good method, Shuang'er, why don't you come?" Thinking of this, Li Changshuang placed his hope on Ye Ningshuang. The main reason is that the small world opened up by the Great Emperor is very different from the ordinary Void Refining Fusion. It's large, and extremely concealed, and it's much safer to set up an imperial magic formation. "Okay." Ye Ningshuang agreed without saying anything, not to mention that she didn't know that Li Changshou had recovered his longevity. She was still feeling guilty, fearing that Li Laoliu would make a mistake and fall when he opened up the world. The three of them left Donghuang Jiang Lan Tower and came to the top of the void.
